changes.newValue: Fixed double exposure bug (was 4+4=8 XP, now 4 only from ship step). Added +1 XP on affinity gain in _sell() and starter contract path. Added +1 XP on mission_completion in all three ship resolution methods (_scrap_ship, _leave_in_orbit, _archive_ship). M1 path: 5 launch + 2 scan + 1 affinity + 1 completion + 4 exposure = 13 XP → Level 2.
